desc:
⚠️ Game may have unexpected bugs - Report bugs to us!
Error code : 267 -> Rejoin!

🎮 Controls are customizable in the settings for each platform.

The fate of the world depends on the battle between the Valorians and the Reavers.
Choose your side and fight in a world of converting robots, powerful weapons, and nonstop action.

🧍 Bot Mode
Move — WASD
Transform — T
Melee — E
Parry — Q
Run — Shift
Dash — Ctrl
Jump — Space
Fire — Left Mouse Button
Aim — Right Mouse Button
Reload — R
Switch Weapons — F

🚗 Vehicle Mode
Drive — WASD
Boost — Shift
Drift — Hold Space
Striker Mode (can fire) — Hold Right Mouse Button
Fire — Hold Left Mouse Button

✈️ Jet Mode
Move — WASD
Boost — Shift
Ascend — Space
Descend — Ctrl
Striker Mode (can fire) — Hold Right Mouse Button
Fire — Hold Left Mouse Button

🚫 Exploiting will result in a PERMANENT ban. There are no second chances!
